packageRules.description: Actions execute in CI with repository credentials. A bumped SHA is a code change and needs a human.

Authorization, storage, and crypto dependencies gate the security model. Review every bump by hand. modernc.org/libc must move only with the modernc.org/sqlite release that pins it: upstream requires the exact pair, so an independent bump breaks the driver.
The runtime base image is pinned by digest, so Renovate is the only thing that keeps it current.
